sources.author: Proteus
patch_list: Kills Facebook auto-init and OneSignal, and opts Firebase Crashlytics/Performance/Analytics out of collection at boot, in Everything Widgets. Widget functionality is unaffected; OneSignal push notifications stop.

Forces the Google license (Pairip) verdict branch to LICENSED and neutralizes the license payload's signature verification, so the patched/re-signed Everything Widgets build always passes store validation.
Bypasses the Google license (Pairip) purchase check of the paid Everything Widgets app: the app runs fully without a Play purchase. Donation SKUs are cosmetic and untouched.
